content_html_sanitized:
Mike Tyson, the former heavyweight champion boxer and now a cannabis entrepreneur, obviously qualifies for medical cannabis, but he is lobbying for Pennsylvania to legalize recreational cannabis.

See

Mike Tyson takes fight for legal marijuana to Harrisburg: 'It's changed my whole life'

 

And of course, the Prohibitionists are questioning his motives. Maybe he is just in it for the money? And maybe they just want to lock people up to satisfy their sado-masochistic fantasies?

See

Medical Education: Developing Medical Cannabis Competencies. A Consensus Statement. The AMA Is Playing Catch Up

And

The Wall Street Journal Carries Excellent Story About The Outrageous Medical Abuse of Veterans: But No Mention of Medical Cannabis

And

As Prohibitionists Lie About Rescheduling Cannabis to Recognize Potential Medical Use, American Cancer Society Website Lists “Possible Benefits of Cannabis for People With Cancer”

 

Athletes are usually thought of as being the healthiest people in society, and they usually are, but they are also the most vulnerable to injury on an unpredictable basis.Should they have their weed dealer on speed dial?

See

Seniors Have Even More Reason to Demand End to Cannabis Prohibition

 

The purpose of the “medical” exemption from marijuana prohibition must be to make it as easy as possible for the sick, dying and disabled to get access to cannabis, not to make it as difficult as possible for everyone who politicians cannot immediately diagnose to get it.

See

Massive New Study of California Cannabis Users Shows Continuum Between Recreational and Medical Use

 

For almost a century now the medical establishment and Prohibitionist politicians have denied that cannabis has any medical value, and now that are having to admit that they were wrong, they are insisting that they should have control over access to something about which they have demonstrated complete ignorance.

 

Dr. Tyson will see you now.
